rules.owner: BatchProgress and the library table count charts (D76, D79); holds_results in src/app/report.cpp is the one reader of RecordStore::record_count()

owner_lines.why: holds_results, the owner: it asks only whether the store is empty

rules.note: D79 B5: RecordStore::record_count() (the old counts() before D115 A1-5) adds up every stored record under every profile, so a line that printed it next to the batch's counts read as a second chart count. This row flags every call to a store's record_count() in src/ and tools/. The one call kept is holds_results in src/app/report.cpp, which asks only whether the store is empty. rules.question: Which code saves charts in groups?
rules.note: D86 items 1 and 2: the batch's writer is the one caller that saves charts in groups, and the one that retries a lost group's charts alone. Another caller opening a group would hold the store lock without that retry. Decided by: D86 items 1 and 2 (task W1)

rules.question: What buffer does a chart file's MD5 read through?
rules.owner: stream_md5's one thread_local buffer in src/app/analysis.cpp
rules.note: S1: a fresh zero-filled megabyte per hashed file cost the library scan measurable time, so each hashing thread keeps one buffer. Decided by: D86 speedups plan, task S1

rules.question: What does a hyhash identify (the old 'chart-file MD5' wording)?
must_match: // `identifier` is the Clone Hero chart-file MD5
must_not_match: // Clone Hero's song id (the join key)

rules.note: ADR 0028: a hyhash is Clone Hero's song id, which for a .sng or .srb is not the MD5 of the chart file. Comments that still called it one were wrong, so comments are scanned too; they name the owner instead. Decided by: ADR 0028 and the derive-once review of 36be3a70 (finding 1)

rules.question: How many sort keys may a report hold?
must_not_match: for (int i = 0; i < specs->SpecsCount && i < max_keys; ++i)
rules.note: A table's header sort can hold more keys than a report sorts by, so the window cuts it to the report's limit, read from the owner. Decided by: D103 item 1 (Shift+click adds a second key); derive-once review of RW-T5 (finding 3)
